description: This Java class 'LocaleUtils' provides utility methods for handling locale and language-related functionality, including extracting locale objects from language or merchant store data and retrieving the request language from an HTTP session.

classes.name: LocaleUtils
classes.description: A utility class for handling locale and language operations in a web application.

methods.name: getLocale
methods.description: Returns a Locale instance based on the provided Language object.

methods.name: getLocale
methods.description: Returns a Locale instance for the given MerchantStore, focusing on currency country code.

methods.name: getRequestLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves the Language object associated with the current HTTP request session, or defaults to the store language.
